name: CtaBand
summary: A call to action in a glass band: a heading, a sentence and a short form, such as a newsletter sign-up.

guidance.useFor: A newsletter sign-up, or one invitation to get in touch, near the end of a page.
insteadUse: A long form: a page of Fields
content: Say what people get and how often, and how to stop
The button says what happens: "Subscribe", not "Submit"
Label the field; a placeholder isn't a label

rungReason: A <section> named by its heading holding a native form with a labelled Field; validation is Field's.

keyboard.action: Reaches the field, then the button
Submits the form from the field or the button

rules: Validate like any Field: errors in words, linked to the field
The field and button stack when narrow (WCAG 1.4.10)
withoutJavaScript: Works fully: the form submits to its action
contrast: An opaque surface (--lue-color-bg-surface) under increased contrast, reduced transparency or without backdrop-filter
